description: This file contains an implementation of the MD5 Message-Digest Algorithm, including functions for initialization, updating, and finalizing MD5 hashes, along with macro definitions for the core MD5 operations.

methods.name: MD5_Init
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 context with standard starting values.

methods.name: MD5_Update
methods.description: Processes input data and updates the MD5 hash state.

methods.name: MD5_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the MD5 hash and outputs the digest.
